data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'melodia' meaning 'song' or 'hymn'. In Christian tradition, Melodee is a name given to those who sing praises to God. The name Melodee carries the meaning “Song of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Melodee usually hope their child will grow to embody song of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
